groups.activity: clan research: Detonite Injector, Ignis, Ogris, then Knux
groups.meta: 72h each, 12 days in series; start first

rows.label: Detonite Injector
rows.note: 5 Detonite Ampule, 200 Ferrite, 250 Polymer Bundle, 100 Plastids, 5,000 cr

rows.label: Ignis
rows.note: 10 Detonite Ampule, 400 Ferrite, 500 Polymer Bundle, 150 Plastids, 5,000 cr

rows.label: Ogris
rows.note: 10 Detonite Ampule, 500 Ferrite, 300 Polymer Bundle, 150 Plastids, 7,500 cr

rows.label: Knux
rows.note: 10 Tellurium, 20,000 Cryotic, 10,000 Polymer Bundle, 5,000 Plastids, 75,000 cr

conditions: Research only; the Injector, Ignis and Ogris are never built for this.
Costs are Ghost clan tier. Shadow pays 3x, Storm 10x, Mountain 30x, Moon 100x, split across members.

rows.label: Cryotic
rows.note: Knux research; 100 per full excavator cycle

conditions: Cryotic only drops from Excavation. The Resource booster doubles it; Resource Drop Chance does not, and Steel Path pays no more.
A destroyed excavator still pays what it completed.
bonuses: A fissure Excavation adds a stacking resource bonus and cracks a relic every 200 Cryotic.
A competent group running several excavators reported about 3,000 Cryotic in a little over 30 minutes.
Resourceful Retriever (18%) or Loyal Retriever (13%) on a companion can double a payout.

disclosures.title: other Cryotic sources
disclosures.body: Excavation nodes are Everest (Earth), Kiliken (Venus), Augustus (Mars), Valefor (Europa), Despina (Neptune) and Hieracon (Pluto). Duviri Circuit pays Cryotic at roughly a tenth of a good Hieracon run.

disclosures.title: keep the excavator fed
disclosures.body: Bring Nekros: Desecrate doubles the Power Cell drops that run excavators. If enemies stop spawning, clear the stragglers; they do not spawn while a squad is scattered.

groups.meta: Polymer and Plastids on one trip
bonuses: Nekros (Desecrate) and Khora (Pilfering Strangledome), with Nova to speed enemies.

groups.activity: build Furax, rank it, then Knux

rows.label: Furax
rows.note: 1,000 Nano Spores, 900 Salvage, 600 Ferrite, 500 Alloy Plate, 30,000 cr; MR 5

rows.label: Knux
rows.note: ranked Furax, 5 Detonite Injector, 10 Gallium, 1 Forma, 30,000 cr

conditions: The Furax is consumed: rank it to 30 first or its Mastery is lost.
Mastery Rank 7 to equip. Knux only works while flying an Archwing.

disclosures.title: leveling
disclosures.body: Salacia, Neptune ranks the weapon in about three runs. The Archwing itself levels slower; Interception nodes or Steel Path open-world bounties are the common answers.
